authority.identity: Current server-validated USER JWT; selected workspace and active membership resolved on every request
authority.row_scope: Preserve approved document/target/ancestry access before pagination, search and counts

input.query: optional bounded document search; only approved searchable fields, never protected raw filename by implication
input.sort: created_desc | created_asc; name/type/size only after field and ordering policy agreement
input.cursor: optional bounded opaque server cursor, never a readable filename or personal identifier

output.items: bounded list of closed authorized entries

entry.display_title: approved minimized title or null; raw file_name is NOT authorized by the existing metadata policy
entry.created_at: authorized ISO instant; field policy required
entry.context: approved safe target and customer references/labels; no private notes or storage identifiers

output.completeness: complete | partial; complete means this authorized query was fully evaluated, not that one page contains all records
output.total_count: exact authorized count only if proven; otherwise null
output.capabilities: explicit metadata search/sort fields; never an implicit byte/download capability

pagination.stable_order: server keyset with deterministic UUID tie-breaker; filter before limit
pagination.binding: actor, workspace, current authorization revision, all filters, query and sort
pagination.scope_or_filter_change: reject stale cursor; no reuse across authority contexts
pagination.concurrency: define snapshot/drift policy; no claim of repeatable snapshot under arbitrary concurrent writes

privacy_decisions_pending: Existing documents.file_name is explicitly protected. Agree minimized title visibility and search/sort policy before returning or indexing it.
Do not leak restricted titles through matches, ordering, totals, errors or readable cursor contents.
Do not put raw document search terms/private titles in request URLs, analytics or logs. Define view-state persistence without treating browser storage as document truth.
Legacy v1 remains unchanged; unknown or partial results must not be converted to an empty complete inventory.

storage.private_bytes: NO_NEW_ENABLEMENT; hosted content and maintenance remain OFF

acceptance_required_real_disposable: A and B positive fixtures, then foreign enumeration/get/search/filter/cursor denied or hidden without counts leakage
123 documents across customers/targets and all pages: no omissions or duplicates
Old document outside first page found by approved search and stable ordering
Combined filters and cursor round-trip; invalid or changed query/scope cursor rejected
Revocation with the exact still-valid JWT denies new reads
Storage unavailable does not break authorized metadata listing
Raw filenames/object paths/tokens/URLs never enter metadata responses or logs

folders: D2 separate agreement and forward migration; persistent workspace hierarchy, CAS/audit/cycle/cross-tenant rules; no localStorage substitute
implementation: No shared API/DTO/RPC/repository/migration changes before W1 agreement; frontend v1 improvement and testable proposed port may proceed independently
